Kite Pickup & Delivery is a game‑changer for managing local delivery and store pickup on my store. It gives my customers clear date and time options at checkout and has removed so much confusion from our fulfillment process. The standout part is the customer support. Every time I’ve asked for help, the team has replied quickly with clear, actionable answers, instead of canned responses. I’ve even requested new features and they shipped working changes for my store within about 6 hours, which is incredibly fast for any app. Setup was straightforward, and the calendar widget looks clean and professional on both desktop and mobile. My team loves the control over cut‑off times, blackout dates, and pickup vs. delivery rules, and my customers love being able to choose the exact time window that works for them. Overall, I’d highly recommend Kite Pickup & Delivery to any brand that cares about timing and wants responsive, developer‑level support behind their app.
